# Nx monorepo workspace patterns: setup, boundaries, affected commands, caching

Curated by Skill Harbor — @wshobson's Nx workspace patterns skill (from the developer-essentials plugin): production patterns for Nx monorepo management. Covers Nx architecture (apps/, libs/, tools/, nx.json), the five library types (feature, ui, data-access, util, shell) with examples, and best practices — do's (consistent tags enforced with module boundaries, caching enabled early, focused libs, generators, documented boundaries) and don'ts (no circular deps, never skip affected, never ignore boundaries, don't over-granularize). The full template library and worked examples live in references/details.md for when you need the concrete templates. Honest caveat: this is a patterns and practices skill, not a generator — it points you at the templates rather than embedding them, and the Nx API details should be verified against your installed Nx version. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
